"import csv
from openpyxl import Workbook

INPUT_FILE = "eng_flag_01.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"

LIMITS = {
    "alt_ft": (9000.0, 18000.0),
    "ias_kt": (135.0, 210.0),
    "load_g": (1.0, 2.2),
}

CHANNELS = ["alt_ft", "ias_kt", "load_g"]


def main():
    # Read the source CSV
    with open(INPUT_FILE, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        rows = [r for r in reader if r and any(str(c).strip() != "" for c in r)]

    header = rows[0]
    idx = {name: header.index(name) for name in ["time", "alt_ft", "ias_kt", "load_g"]}
    data_rows = rows[1:]

    wb = Workbook()

    # ---------- Sheet DATA ----------
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "DATA"
    ws.append(["time", "alt_ft", "ias_kt", "load_g",
               "status_alt", "status_ias", "status_load"])

    values_by_channel = {ch: [] for ch in CHANNELS}

    for r in data_rows:
        r = list(r) + [""] * (len(header) - len(r))  # pad short rows

        time_val = r[idx["time"]].strip()
        out_row = [time_val]

        for ch in CHANNELS:
            raw = r[idx[ch]].strip()
            if raw == "":
                out_row.append(None)      # keep cell truly empty
                out_row.append("MISSING")
            else:
                val = float(raw)
                out_row.append(val)
                values_by_channel[ch].append(val)
                lo, hi = LIMITS[ch]
                out_row.append("OVER" if (val < lo or val > hi) else "OK")

        ws.append(out_row)

    # ---------- Sheet STATS ----------
    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("STATS")
    ws2.append(["channel", "min", "max", "mean"])
    for ch in sorted(CHANNELS):
        vals = values_by_channel[ch]
        if vals:
            ws2.append([ch,
                        round(min(vals), 3),
                        round(max(vals), 3),
                        round(sum(vals) / len(vals), 3)])
        else:
            ws2.append([ch, None, None, None])

    wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
